text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loaned(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ Loaned(ailton, braga) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton. Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga. Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ∧ FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga. Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (FootballPlayer(x) ∧ Loaned(x, y) ∧ FootballClub(y)) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
